state.purpose: Independent source-only compiler triage. Concrete conditional calls are valid C#. The namespace action promises to update dependent references. Friend assemblies are supported by existing tests. Source and compiler proofs, not probabilities, decide defects.

conditional_registration_excluded.instructions: Does IsRegistrationSyntax exclude a concrete app?.AddRequestHandler<Handler>() invocation from both generation and the unsupported-call-site diagnostic?

namespace_repair_drops_nested_parent.instructions: For a qualified constructor Old.Price.Key, can the annotated constructor-reference rewrite replace the complete left side Old.Price with the target namespace and drop Price?

friend_catalog_extension_ambiguous.instructions: When assembly A grants InternalsVisibleTo to B and both generated catalogs expose this same extension method in Cntryl.Portia, can a catalog.AddPortiaGeneratedDomainEvents() call in B be ambiguous between A and B?
